([[Seattle, Washington]]) | college = [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]] (2018–2020) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * First-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] ([[2019–20 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) * Pac-12 All-Freshman Team ([[2018–19 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|2019]]) }} '''Charles James Elleby''' (born June 16, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State Cougars]]. ==Early life and high school career== Elleby was born in [[Federal Way, Washington]] and grew up in [[Seattle, Washington]] and attended [[Cleveland High School (Seattle)|Cleveland High School]].{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/812655/2019/02/12/meet-cj-elleby-the-no-star-prospect-having-one-of-best-freshman-seasons-in-washington-state-history/|title=Meet CJ Elleby, the unheralded prospect having one of the best freshman seasons in Washington State history|first=Vince|last=Grippi|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=February 12, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}} As a sophomore, Elleby averaged 16 points and 10 rebounds and helped lead Cleveland to the state playoffs. He averaged 23.0 points, 13.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists per game and was named second team All-[[Metro League (Seattle)|Metro League]] in his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2017/nov/13/washington-state-inks-seattle-forward-charles-elle/|title=Washington State inks Seattle forward Charles Elleby to letter of intent|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=November 13, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby averaged 23.5 points per game as a senior and was named first team All-Metro and first team All-State by the [[Associated Press]] and ''[[The News Tribune]]''.{{cite web|url=https://dailyevergreen.com/44819/sports/td-athlete-of-the-week/|title=Athlete of the Week: CJ Elleby|first=Shawn|last=O'Connor|work=[[The Daily Evergreen]]|date=January 8, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby committed to play college basketball at [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]] early in his senior year over offers from [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]] and [[Seattle Redhawks men's basketball|Seattle]].{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/high-school/clevelands-cj-elleby-commits-to-washington-state-for-basketball/|title=Cleveland’s CJ Elleby commits to Washington State for basketball|first=Nathan|last=Joyce|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=September 9, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/washington-state/Article/CFC-talks-to-future-Coug-Elleby-and-his-dad-a-longtime-fixture-on-Seattle-prep-basketball-scene-107382434/|title=Hoops: What made Seattle’s CJ Elleby choose crimson over purple?|first=Barry|last=Bolton|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=September 13, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}} ==College career== Elleby averaged 14.7 points and 7.1 per game as a true freshman and was named to the [[Pac-12 Conference]]'s All-Freshman team.{{cite web|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2019/10/24/return-of-cj-elleby-good-news-for-washington-state-hoops/40413571/|title=Return of CJ Elleby good news for Washington State hoops|first=Nicholas|last=Geranios|work=[[USA Today]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=October 24, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/washington-state/Article/Washington-State-basketball-Robert-Franks-CJ-Elleby-Cougs-Cougars-Wazzu--129957088/|title=WSU hoops: Franks first-team All-Pac-12; Elleby All-Freshman|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=March 11, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}} He scored a season high 26 points against [[Washington–Washington State men's basketball rivalry|rival]] [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]].{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2019/feb/15/cj-elleby-has-been-a-rare-rookie-for-washington-st/|title=CJ Elleby has been a rare rookie for Washington State, and the Cougars are reaping the full benefits of his skills|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=February 15, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}} In wake of the firing of WSU head coach [[Ernie Kent]], Elleby initially declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent and ultimately decided to return to Washington State for his sophomore season.{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2019/mar/29/washington-state-freshman-cj-elleby-declares-for-n/|title=Washington State freshman CJ Elleby declares for NBA draft, won't hire agent immediately|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=March 29, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/wsu-cougar-basketball/cleveland-high-product-cj-elleby-withdraws-from-nba-draft-and-will-return-to-wsu/|title=Cleveland High product CJ Elleby withdraws from NBA draft and will return to WSU|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=May 28, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://lmtribune.com/sports/stock-for-elleby-cougs-clearly-on-the-rise/article_646ffda5-42bf-54a4-8629-03a02a3f820a.html|title=Stock for Elleby, Cougs clearly on the rise|first=Colton|last=Clark|work=[[Lewiston Morning Tribune]]|date=February 1, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby entered his sophomore season as a preseason first team All-Pac-12 selection and was named to the [[Julius Erving Award|Julius Erving]] and [[John R. Wooden Award|Wooden Award]] watchlists.{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-basketball/uws-jaden-mcdaniels-wsu-cj-elleby-chosen-to-preseason-watch-list/|title=UW's Jaden McDaniels, WSU CJ Elleby chosen to preseason watch list|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=October 16, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby was named the Pac-12 Player of the Week on January 20, 2020 after scoring 25 points with a career-high 14 rebounds in 72–61 victory against eighth-ranked [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] and scoring 22 points with nine rebounds and five assists in a 89–76 win over [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cougcenter.com/2020/1/21/21074767/hca-cj-elleby-pac-12-wsu-cougars-basketball|title=HCA: CJ Elleby named Pac-12 Player of the Week|first=Nick|last=Nordi|website=CougCenter.com|date=January 21, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby scored a career-high 27 points with 12 rebounds and hit a go ahead three pointer with four seconds left to beat Arizona State 67–65.{{cite web|url=https://collegebasketball.ap.org/article/ellebys-3-leads-washington-st-victory-over-arizona-st|title=Elleby’s 3 Leads Washington St. To Victory Over Arizona St.|work=[[Associated Press]]|date=January 30, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}} Elleby set a new career high with 34 points while also grabbing 10 rebounds on February 9, 2020 in a 79–67 win over Washington.{{cite web|url=https://www.thenewstribune.com/sports/college/university-of-washington/article239922243.html|title=UW Huskies drop sixth straight as CJ Elleby leads Washington State to 79–67 win|first=Lauren|last=Kirschman|work=[[The News Tribune]]|date=February 9, 2020|access-date=February 10, 2020}} Elleby became the third-fastest player in Cougars' history to score 1,000 career points during a 21-point performance in a 78–74 win over Washington to complete a regular season sweep of the Huskies.{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2020/feb/28/washington-state-cj-elleby-joins-1000-point-club-i/|title=Washington State’s CJ Elleby joins 1,000-point club in return to Seattle|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=February 28, 2020|access-date=February 29, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Elleby was named to the First Team All-Pac-12.{{Cite web|url=https://pac-12.com/article/2020/03/08/2019-20-pac-12-mens-basketball-all-conference-awards-announced|title=Pac-12 announces 2019-20 Men's Basketball annual major awards|date=March 9, 2020|website=pac-12.com|access-date=March 9, 2020}} As a sophomore, Elleby averaged 18.4 points and 7.8 rebounds per game.{{cite news |title=Washington St. faces ASU in Pac-12 quarters |url=https://apnews.com/83f7d424521e47b48640146c4cddf478 |accessdate=April 12, 2020 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 12, 2020}} Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=Washington State's CJ Elleby to test NBA draft waters again |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29072203/washington-state-cj-elleby-test-nba-draft-waters-again |accessdate=April 30, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=April 20, 2020}} On July 31, Elleby announced he was remaining in the draft, forgoing two seasons of college eligibility.{{cite news |title=Washington State’s CJ Elleby to keep name in NBA draft, won’t return for junior season |url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/wsu-cougar-basketball/washington-states-cj-elleby-to-keep-name-in-nba-draft-wont-return-for-junior-season/
